{{Quote|Why, sure. It's a General Spacetronics ''MaKing''-class transport. The rear flanges mean it's the Janako model &mdash; made locally under license.|Roark Garnet|<ref name="TRG1-34" />}}
The '''''MaKing''-class transport''' was a [[Transport/Legends|space transport]] built by [[General Spacetronics]].

==Characteristics==
Built by [[General Spacetronics]], the ''MaKing''-class were armed [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Some models of the vessel were built by local interests under license, such as "[[Janako]]" model, which was distinguishable by the unique flanges at the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] rear.<ref name="TRG1-34" />

==History==
[[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] was able to identify a [[Unidentified Janako|modified Janako model]] ''MaKing''-class transport by its flanges, and determined that modifications had been made around its gunports which would have upgraded the vessel's firepower.<ref name="TRG1-34" />
